project_comments.note: Gold Nugget — Constraint Documentation Template: Across WP-001, WP-004, the best constraints follow a consistent five-part structure: (1) Rule statement, (2) Rationale, (3) Anti-pattern code block, (4) Correct-pattern code block, (5) Forbidden-patterns list or extension notes. This template produces unambiguous, self-contained constraints that agents can apply without reading surrounding context. Recommend formalizing this structure as a META-CONSTRAINT at the top of both constraints.md files (mcp-server and personas) so future agents generating new constraints follow the same format consistently. Actions: (a) Add a 'How to write a constraint' section to both constraints.md preambles. (b) Audit existing constraints that lack anti-pattern/correct-pattern blocks and backfill where the rule is non-obvious. Priority: low — follow-up housekeeping ticket recommended."

Timestamp ordering artifact in WP-003: the QA pipeline was given artificial timestamps (completed_at: 19:40Z) that are ~1 hour in the future relative to the current system clock (18:36Z UTC on 2026-03-01). As a result, hasNewUpstreamPassSince('qa','code-review') fires on every ledger_get_next_action call, creating an infinite re-review loop. Two code-review PASS pipelines were completed at 18:36Z — both PASS, no blocking issues, all 8 AC met. The loop will self-resolve once real time passes 19:40Z UTC (approximately 1 hour). For future cycles: QA agents should use current system time (new Date()) for pipeline timestamps rather than artificial future times to prevent re-engagement false-positives.
